title: Head Lantern
body:
"Sometimes all we need in life is lampy... always being there... so warm and bright..."

Description

Head Lantern is a UGC item that can emit a light if you join Oaklands while wearing it.

Unlike all other items obtainable in the game, the Head Lantern needs to be bought for 150 Robux (112 with premium) in the creator marketplace. It will produce an orange light, similar to the normal Lantern.

Trivia

  • When you have this equipped and join Oaklands it will emit a light.
  • Though this produces light, it is not very bright, proving the Miner's Helmet to be a much better alternative.
